title: Candied Hazelnuts
ldInstructionsRaw: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan, moving them around often and ensuring that they do not get dark. Place the sugar in a saucepan with 3 1/2 tablespoons of water and melt it until it reaches 250°F. Add in the hazelnuts, remove from the heat, and mix until the sugar completely coats the hazelnuts and turns white.

Place the saucepan back over the heat and melt the sugar again, cooking until it caramelizes. Spread the hazelnuts out on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and let cool. Place them in little bags or in paper cones.
